description: Details of one centre: address, phone, opening hours (Paris time), upcoming closures, accepted payment methods (online / on site / card-only), free parking hours, whether it is open now and bookable today, and its vehicle price categories (s/m/l/xl/moto) with example models — prices depend on the category.
